fieldDescription: Turns the whole colony management module on or off.

fieldName: One major crisis at a time
fieldDescription: While a Hegemony, Tri-Tachyon, Persean League, Sindrian Diktat or Luddic Church crisis is running (or during the cooldown), no other major-faction crisis can be picked. Pirates, the Luddic Path and the Remnant are never blocked. If none of them can strike either, the crisis bar holds just below the point where a crisis is picked.
Days after a major crisis ends before the next major crisis can be picked.

fieldName: Bar reset after a crisis: minimum
fieldDescription: Lowest progress the crisis bar resets to after a crisis fires. Vanilla: 0.

fieldName: Bar reset after a crisis: maximum
fieldDescription: Highest progress the crisis bar resets to after a crisis fires. Vanilla: 400. The roll favours the low end.
